subject.title: [Bug]: Secret provider crash-loop exhausts 1Password service account rate limits

question: What startup SecretRef failure policy should OpenClaw support for exec providers under supervisor restarts to prevent external secret-provider rate-limit exhaustion?
rationale: The code can be changed in several plausible ways, but choosing between fail-fast security, bounded retry, degraded startup, circuit breaking, and new config surface is a maintainer/security product decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Generic bounded startup policy
options.body: Add a vendor-neutral startup retry/degrade policy with clear diagnostics and tests, while keeping provider-specific batching and caching in resolver plugins.

options.title: Docs and external resolver path only
options.body: Keep runtime fail-fast unchanged and document supervisor restart limits plus batching/caching resolver plugins such as the Varlock 1Password plugin linked in the discussion.

options.title: Configurable retry/circuit surface
options.body: Add an explicit `secrets` retry or circuit-breaker config surface with migration/docs/tests, accepting the added configuration compatibility burden.

recommendation.title: Generic bounded startup policy
recommendation.body: Add a vendor-neutral startup retry/degrade policy with clear diagnostics and tests, while keeping provider-specific batching and caching in resolver plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans security posture and product policy, and steipete is tied to the original external-secrets commit/merge history plus the issue timeline.
